data.one_liner: A Dart library to process string-based templates using expressions.
data.what_it_does: It processes string-based templates using built-in or custom expressions. It supports various expression syntaxes such as hash, mustache, pipe, and standard Dart-like string interpolation, alongside many built-in context objects like Codex, Crypto, DateFormat, and FileSystem.
use_when: You need to parse and evaluate text templates with embedded Dart-like expressions.
You want support for multiple template syntaxes like mustache or hash blocks.
avoid_when: You are looking for full heavy-weight HTML templating engines with looping/conditional markup control flow.
You need compile-time code generation for your templates.
strengths: Multiple syntax options (hash, mustache, pipe, standard).
Rich set of built-in context objects and helpers including crypto, date formatting, and file systems.
weaknesses: Limited documentation on some advanced objects in the provided material.
Requires proper escaping for certain standard interpolation syntaxes.
data.setup_notes: Add template_expressions to pubspec.yaml and run dart pub get.
data.minimal_example:
final template = Template('##firstName.toUpperCase()##', syntax: [HashExpressionSyntax()]);
final result = template.apply({'firstName': 'John'});
